correctness.rationale: The ambient norm on H1 is beta*a·a, beta=k(n-k)/(n(n-1)). The coefficient zero-sum hyperplane splits orthogonally into t-1 on-T contrasts, q-1 outside contrasts and one mixed contrast. Conditioning on omission of T gives eigenvalues 1, 1-p0*n(n-1)(q-k)/(q(q-1)(n-k)), and 1-p0*k(n-1)t/(q(n-k)); their difference factors as -p0*(n-1)*(n-(t+1)k)/((q-1)(n-k)), so the sharp ordering holds for all t>=3,k>=2,q=n-t>=k. Positive sampled norms establish injectivity, even at q=k where outside eigenvalue=1; the finite-dimensional singular value theorem gives the recovery norm. Independently direct probability-matrix checks covered 120 parameter triples with four ties.
